scope: StructureClaw request-scoped analysis and partial delivery; no Bench/evaluation or independent commercial API changes
acceptance: Force-only horizontal single-span beam calculation has no fictional material/stiffness, uses shared run/archive/query services, and has forces/reactions views without deformation.
Specified engines and complete models retain the real solver path; ordinary analysis does not automatically request code design or a report.
Partial force execution retains the complete accepted response goal and explicitly records missing displacement; narrower tool arguments cannot mark the whole request complete.
Source draft, evidence, revision, settings and request sequence protect current results; unsupported physics and unavailable response quantities are rejected.
Automatic scalar queries consume the server tool permissions and budget; disabled or exhausted queries remain explicit delivery deficiencies.

limits: This record certifies the tested product flows, not 300 authored Bench cases or a 100% language-model answer rate.

Equilibrium supports only validated horizontal one-member simply-supported/left-fixed beams with explicit point loads/full-span UDL and linear case combinations. Other structures retain full-model solvers.
Missing design information and unreviewed section catalogs remain explicit; no fabricated design values or catalog properties.
Commercial SDKs/APIs were not changed or re-certified in this scope.
Real-provider response latency varied from roughly 1 to 4 minutes per tested single-turn case.
